note: CSS migration ratchet (css-migration-plan.md, Phase 0). These numbers may only go DOWN. A rise is a regression; a fall means this file is stale and must be lowered in the same commit, so progress can never be spent silently. Regenerate deliberately with `npm run css:metrics -- --baseline`. `info` is context and is not compared: a legitimate feature adds rules and lines, so those are not ratcheted.
